run_preservation:
# 8 TB True-91 B Baseline Log Preservation

## Disposition

- The first baseline run started at 2026-08-22 07:00:21 UTC and completed its
  full `fillrandom,flush,compact0,waitforcompaction,stats,levelstats` sequence.
- The shared `load.sh` was modified in place while the first run was active.
  When the first `db_bench` returned, Bash resumed reading the modified file at
  the old byte offset and unintentionally launched the measurement block a
  second time.
- The second run started at 2026-08-24 05:14:11 UTC and was deliberately
  terminated with SIGTERM at 2026-08-24 11:34 UTC after the incident was
  confirmed.
- The incomplete second-run database directory was deleted after all available
  logs were preserved. It is not recoverable from this workspace.
- This artifact must not be treated as a clean device-write-amplification run.
  `diskstats.start` was overwritten as an empty file and two `iostat` processes
  wrote to the same output file.

## Preserved logs

- `scaling_91b_none/baseline_8000gb_91b_none/bench.out`: original mixed log,
  retained unchanged after termination.
- `preserved/bench.first_complete.out`: lines 1--489915 of the mixed log; the
  complete first run.
- `preserved/bench.second_interrupted.out`: lines 489916--550336 of the mixed
  log; the interrupted second run.
- `scaling_91b_none/run.log`: runner output, including the malformed
  `oc/diskstats` command and the later unbound-variable error.
- `scaling_91b_none/baseline_8000gb_91b_none/raw/time.out`: GNU time output for
  the interrupted second run only. The first run's time file was overwritten.
- `scaling_91b_none/baseline_8000gb_91b_none/raw/iostat.log`: retained for
  forensic purposes only; it is not a valid time series.

## Recoverable first-run result

- Operations: 94,394,885,626
- `fillrandom` time: 166,310.973 seconds (46.1975 hours)
- Throughput: 567,580 operations/s, 49.3 MB/s
- Final RocksDB uptime: approximately 166,414 seconds
- `waitforcompaction`: completed with status `OK`
- Estimated pending compaction bytes at completion: 0
- Final reported LSM size: 6.46 TB
- RocksDB-reported cumulative compaction write: 176,695.7 GB
- RocksDB-reported compaction write amplification: 20.2

The first run overlapped briefly with the concurrent 100 GB subcompaction
diagnostic. Treat its timing as a completed but not fully isolated measurement.
The engine statistics above are recoverable; host-visible device write
amplification is not.

## Interrupted second-run state

- Wall time before termination: 6:20:11
- Last reported ingest: 1,359.96 GB
- Partial DB size before deletion: 1.2 TB
- Maximum resident set size: 24,892,640 KB
- `/proc/<db_bench>/io` immediately before termination reported
  19,570,711,592,960 read bytes and 20,624,729,243,648 write bytes. These are
  diagnostic process counters, not a replacement for the planned device-write
  metric.
